title: sensel
description: `sensel` is an L2Ork external for connecting a Sensel Morph multitouch controller and reporting its contact data, including position, force, area, orientation, and movement deltas. Its left outlet emits numbered 20-value contact lists and contact-count messages, while the right outlet reports connection status; use `discover` to connect to the first available device or `connect <serial-number>` to select one explicitly.
